title: Add cockpit and ROI invariant verifiers in susi-harness
goal: Add WorkerRoi::verify_worker_roi_invariants, RoiReport::verify_roi_report_invariants, SovaRankedCandidate::verify_ranked_candidate_invariants, and SovaDecision::verify_decision_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/roi.rs, and MissionView::verify_mission_view_invariants, WorkerView::verify_worker_view_invariants, and Snapshot::verify_snapshot_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/cockpit.rs.
